note: Synthetic vectors authored against the pinned regulator text. All amounts are independent synthetic values; refusal vectors exercise declared exclusion branches. Not a Shariah ruling.

domain_errors: REFUSED_BENCHMARK_BOUNDS_MISSING: a benchmark-determined rental requires both floor_rental_minor_units and cap_rental_minor_units
REFUSED_TAKAFUL_MISSING: a schedule requires a takaful line (takaful_minor_units_per_month) or a declared conventional_insurance_exception with its insurance line
REFUSED_TAKAFUL_CONFLICT: conventional_insurance_exception applies only when no takaful line is declared
REFUSED_WAD_TRIGGER: wad_purchase_trigger voluntary_early_purchase cannot trigger a wa'd to purchase; only default or breach of terms may
REFUSED_UNILATERAL_RENTAL_INCREASE: a rental revision requires mutual_revision_agreed: true; the lessor must not raise the rental unilaterally
AUTHORITY_NOT_PINNED: authority aaoifi is not pinned; supported: bnm_malaysia
REFUSED_FLOOR_EXCEEDS_CAP: floor_rental_minor_units must not exceed cap_rental_minor_units
REFUSED_INPUT_INSURANCE: insurance_minor_units_per_month is required when conventional_insurance_exception is set
REFUSED_INPUT_TENOR: pp.tenor_months must be an integer up to 360 of at least 1 when present
REFUSED_INPUT_LOSS_MONTH: total_loss_month must fall within the tenor
REFUSED_INPUT_FAULT_FLAG: lessee_fault applies only together with total_loss_month
REFUSED_INPUT_BENCHMARK_PATH: benchmark_path_bp must be an array with exactly tenor_months = 12 monthly values
REFUSED_INPUT_WRONG_TYPE: policy_parameters must be an object
